positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Utilized Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, and the Azure portal to provisioned Azure infrastructure resources such as virtual machines, virtual networks, application gateways, firewalls, and Azure Data Factory  Pipelines
* Created .NET Core Web API endpoints
* Modified Jenkins pipeline scripts to support new infrastructure resources
* Developed BitBucket pipelines for deploying web applications and WebAPI projects to various pre-production environments
* Utilized Postman to verify validity and test functionality of WebAPI endpoints
* Deployed and configured web applications and windows services
* Authored service that leverages SalesForce REST API to transfer data between SalesForce and a SQL Server database
positions.insights: Skills: Azure · Cloud Computing · C# · REST APIs · .NET Framework · .NET Core · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
●	Automated the provisioning and configuring of infrastructure resources such as on-premise and Azure virtual machines, Azure application services, and other miscellaneous Azure resources 
●	Worked on the creation and support of multiple automated software delivery pipelines 
●	Gathered requirements for multiple Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) projects 
●	Worked with vendors to resolve various integration issues 
●	Created a Groovy function library of the most commonly used Jenkins build steps, making our delivery pipelines more consistent and easier to maintain

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Lead the development effort of a proprietary, web-based, content management system using HTML5, JavaScript, C#, Web API, Window Services and SQL Server 
●	Worked with vendors in all stages of the software development life cycle
●	Participated in deployment of TFS as a project management solution: performing various administrative tasks, authoring user stories, and building shared queries
●	Participated in every day support of VB.Net, C#, SQL Server legacy systems
●	Reverse engineered failing VB.net/C# legacy systems that required support 
●	Adopted the use of NUnit for unit and integration testing as part of the development team’s coding practice
●	Rewrote SQL Server stored procedures, reducing the execution time from over two minutes down to three to five seconds
●	Held a major role in the migration of customer data from a single volume across multiple volumes
●	Managed a dynamic software development team
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET AJAX · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET · jQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Participated in the development of Subway’s international web site using Sitecore content management system, ASP.net, C#, Bootstrap, JQuery, and CSS 
●	Participated in the development of a ASP.net/c#, web based menu administration tool that reduce the time to update web site menus by half
●	Wrote SQL Server stored procedures to synchronize nutrition information
●	Worked with vendor to develop new version of batch job for processing customer feedback forms
●	Applied critical thinking skills to solve time sensitive, production environment issues
●	Provide support for production systems
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · HTML5 · ASP.NET · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
●	Responsible for designing and overseeing software development and application support
●	Automated the creation and delivery of QuickBooks Reports using C#, QuickBooks API, and Asp.Net Web Services
●	Create ASP.net Web API service as an interface to SQL Server database
●	Maintained company website
●	Added several modules to company website using C#, AJAX, JavaScript, SQL Server, WCF
●	Utilized C#, VSTO, and ADO.net to create an Excel Add-in to support the transfer of data into multiple database tables, resulting in time saving of several hours per file
●	Created an Excel VBA module to update web site’s database
●	Designed database schema to support data driven web-site
●	Deployed SQL Server Reporting Services 
●	Created several SQL Server Reporting Services report models to facilitate ad-hoc reporting
●	Provided internal employees with training on proper use and troubleshooting of website and Excel add-in
●	Perform analysis of systems acquired through strategic acquisition 
●	Worked with vendors to design new company website

company.name: SIGHTLINES, LLC, A LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY OF CONNECTICUT

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
●	Developed and supported enterprise level web applications as well as support day-to­ day enterprise systems integration
●	Using Asp.Net, C#, ADO.Net, created a web application to configure a custom invoice application through Oracle
●	Use of Visual Basic.Net and ADO.Net to bind Oracle Database tables to ASP.Net form controls and to save data to SQL Server Tables
●	Use Visual Basic.Net and C# Net to Integrate ASP.Net data-grid controls to Excel spreadsheet for custom reporting applications
●	Increased performance of Visual Basic.Net based, ASP.Net, Oracle driven report from minutes to seconds
●	Integrated Microsoft Enterprise Library data access components with existing application
●	Utilized VBScript to automate the transmission of flat files to and from Oracle in support of business critical applications
●	Utilized SQL Server DTS to move data from Oracle to SQL Server
●	Assured business continuity by working closely with vendors during outage of critical business applications

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
●	Collaborated with clients to gather requirements and analyze needs in areas of automation, manual tasks, and workflow optimization  
●	Partnered with vendors to troubleshoot and resolve client environments issues.
●	Streamlined workflows that extend across multiple databases  Composed  technical documentation for delivery to customers
●	Created composite controls using Visual Basic.Net and ASP.Net technologies to facilitate user data entry
●	Used ADO.Net to integrate data from relational database system with ASP. Net web controls like fields and data grid controls
●	Developed Visual Basic.Net classes to interface with Documentum and Stellent content management suites’ workflow and version management engines
●	Used Visual Basic.Net to import data from Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet to Stellent’s Sarbanes Oxley Solution
●	Key player in development group, engineering Lotus Domino application to track testing of nuclear waste for U.S. Department of Energy.
●	Created company intranets using Stellent Content Management suite.
●	Integrated Stellent Document Management  System with CoreChange Coreport Portal
●	Customized Stellent Content Server for digital assets management system
